description: Create a theme — a.k.a. a CLUSTER, and the same record as the delivery program it drives. Themes give the roadmap structure above individual initiatives and are what the strategy layer ties to. Requires `write` scope.

description.description: What this theme covers and why it matters.

objective.description: Free-text outcome for the roadmap card. Not the strategy link: work reaches an objective when its initiatives name key results (anyforge_set_initiative_key_results).

status.description: Theme status. Allowed: NOW | NEXT | LATER | DONE | ARCHIVED (default NOW). LATER is shown as "Beyond".

name: anyforge_create_theme
title: Create theme
